corrections.reason: The cell rests on the revised column of a two-column service level agreement while the ledger's own claim_hyderabad_water_which_sla_in_force_unknown records that which procedure governs on the access date is not established by any reviewed public page. The two columns differ materially (15 days versus 60 for payment of connection charges; 5 versus 29 for consumer account number generation), so selecting one is an inference the ledger expressly declines to draw. Protocol section 8 requires a stated cell to give a value a citizen can act on and provides that an Unknown claim records a limitation, not a positive cell value; a disclosing note cannot convert that limitation into a stated value. Section 8 tolerates incompleteness in a time cell but not indeterminacy between two published, mutually exclusive schedules. The topic is named and figures appear, so mentioned is the correct state.

corrections.new: Searched the board's Single Window Cell service level agreement and the board site's Timelines for New Connection route. Timing is named and stage figures are published for a Category I 15mm connection, but the same document sets out two procedures side by side and does not say which governs. Under the revised procedure the stages run 7 working days to pay the processing fee, 6 and 5 days of feasibility checks, 5 days to re-upload missed documents, 15 days to pay the connection charges, Green Brigade allotment within 24 hours of payment and 5 days to generate the consumer account number. Under the existing procedure the corresponding stages run 15, 10 and 20 days of feasibility checks, 10 days to capture documents, 5 days for proceeding generation, 60 days to pay the connection charges and 29 days to generate the consumer account number. The charter fixes that days mean working days, but no reviewed public page establishes which procedure applies on the access date, and the agreement is undated on its face. A citizen therefore cannot tell whether the payment window is 15 days or 60. That gap is carried as claim_hyderabad_water_which_sla_in_force_unknown. No total is published for either procedure; the figures are per stage.

corrections.reason: Protocol section 1 requires one claim to assert one checkable thing, and section 8 lint item 1 flags compound claims. This claim asserted four things across two unrelated topics: two post-submission surfaces (status tracking, SMS to the applicant) and two help resources available at or before submission (an online-application user manual, a help desk and kiosks). Protocol section 8 provides that a step at or before submission is not after-submission evidence, so the two halves fall on opposite sides of an express boundary while the claim is the principal support for the after-submission cell. The claim is trimmed to the post-submission surfaces; the help resources move to claim_hyderabad_water_application_help_resources.
